target_offset_note:
SYSTEMATIC TARGET CORRECTION in link_base metres, applied to every grounded target by bringup/approach_target.py unless a profile is named.

DEFAULT [0.003, -0.020, 0.040] -- measured 2026-09-01 against the elevator CALL button and then applied UNCHANGED to the ADA door plate, a different target on a different wall at a different pose, where the press landed MORE CENTRED than without it. A correction that improves two unrelated targets is a property of the rig. The hand-eye solve behind it is sound: 2.96 mm RMS, worst 8.2 mm, 10 pairs, 63.8 deg rotation spread. The correction is almost entirely lateral and vertical with only 3 mm along the approach axis, which is the shape of a camera-to-arm offset and NOT a depth-lift bias (that was the first hypothesis and it was wrong).

REVERTED TO IT 2026-09-06, on operator instruction. Between 2026-09-05 and then the default had been walked twice -- y -0.020 -> -0.045, then x +8 mm and y +7 mm back -- reaching [0.011, -0.038, 0.040]. BOTH of those steps were tuned against ONE target: the floor-select button inside the floor-2 lift car. Neither was ever re-checked against the ADA plate or the call button, and they were nevertheless applied to every press the rig makes. That is the difference between a calibration and a fudge: the 2026-09-01 value earned the word calibration by being validated on a second, unrelated target, and the in-car steps never did. On 2026-09-06 the ADA press made contact but landed off, with the in-car value active.

The in-car tuning is NOT deleted -- it is kept in target_offset_profiles.lift_car_select and is still the best value anyone has measured for that specific 25 mm button. Select it with approach_target.py --offset-profile lift_car_select (or UTP_OFFSET_PROFILE), which is what the in-car press should use and nothing else should.

WHAT WOULD INVALIDATE THE DEFAULT: re-running the hand-eye solve, remounting the camera or the arm, or changing the tool. Re-measure against BOTH a large target and a small one -- a 120 mm ADA plate alone cannot see an error that 25 mm buttons expose immediately.
